compose_fleet.note: Composed fleets are synthetic: single-agent StepShield trajectories interleaved as concurrent agents. Not recorded multi-agent data.
compose_fleet.dataset: StepShield train, DEC excluded; components M1-unflagged when replayed alone

convergence_synth.caveat: Mechanism test: detection capability under an engineered condition. It does not measure how often target convergence occurs in real agent fleets or whether it predicts harm; that remains open (bench/git_history.py was underpowered).
